biggest_catch: $99 annual fee: the 140,000 points only matter if you actually stay at IHG hotels — points you never use are worth nothing, and the $99 fee is real money. Only planned business spending counts toward the $4,000-in-3-months; never inflate business spend to chase points. Applying triggers a hard credit inquiry, and carrying a balance at the card's ~20%+ variable APR erases the bonus fast — pay in full every month.
catches: Only pursue spending you already planned to do — never buy extra things just to hit a bonus threshold; overspending to chase a bonus wipes out the bonus math and is how people lose money on it.
The 140,000 points are IHG hotel points, not cash — they have real value only if you stay at IHG properties.
The 24-month same-product exclusion is strict: current cardmembers and anyone who got this product's bonus in the last 24 months is out.
The extra 10,000 points require adding an employee card and purchases on it within 3 months.
Applying triggers a hard credit inquiry, which can temporarily dip your credit score by a few points.
The card's variable APR (~20%+) will erase the bonus fast if you carry a balance — pay the full statement balance every month.
